diagram_previews.alt: Isosceles right triangle ABC with apex A on top (right-angle mark at A) and side AC labelled 10. K is the midpoint of AB, with tick marks on its two halves; the red dashed perpendicular bisector of AB (right-angle mark at K) passes through M, the midpoint of the base BC. A grey dashed segment joins A to M, with a right-angle mark at M.
